_comment: Ground truth for the RO4 evaluation.
One entry per curated regression-inducing pull request. 'expected' lists the
features that genuinely regressed, established by cross-referencing the diff,
the linked issue report and the fix commit, as described in proposal section 5.3.
Feature names must match the feature_name values in the evaluation registry
risk_level is the label a correct analysis should produce:
High   - the feature's own production code area changed directly
Medium - the feature depends indirectly on changed production code
Low    - only test files or documentation touched the feature's area
A feature absent from 'expected' is treated as correctly omitted, so any
prediction naming it counts as a false positive.
label_status is 'proposed' until the researcher has checked the label
against the linked issue and fix commit, then 'verified'. The evaluation
command warns while any label remains unverified; do not report figures
Proposal 5.3 targets 15 to 20 pull requests. Add further entries in the
same shape, covering all three risk levels across all three repositories.

pull_requests.note: Fixes a regression in the ExcludeIf rule by requiring a Closure rather than any callable. Changes Validation/Rules/ExcludeIf.php directly.
Patches a nested array validation rule regression in Validation/ValidationRuleParser.php. ValidationRuleParser is deliberately not a registered code area, so a keyword match cannot find this.
Fixes a regression when only some route parameters are scoped. Changes Routing/ImplicitRouteBinding.php directly.
Fixes URL generation with optional parameters, a regression from #54811. Changes Routing/RouteUrlGenerator.php and the shared Routing/Route.php, which route model binding also reads.
Fixes a regression with Factory::guessModelNamesUsing(). Changes Eloquent/Factories/Factory.php and the shared test lifecycle that prepares the database for assertions.
Adds regression tests for inRandomOrder. Changes tests/Database/DatabaseQueryBuilderTest.php only; no production code.
Adds an updateOrCreate regression test for HasManyThrough. Changes a test file only; no production code.
Fixes a regression in ActiveRecord::Result#column_types. Changes active_record/result.rb directly; attribute access consumes the column types it produces.
Adds a regression test for development routes source mapping. Changes railties/test/rails_info_controller_test.rb only; no production code.
Fixes a regression in urlize for multi-part domain names. Changes django/utils/html.py directly.
Adds an inspectdb regression test for sqlite_master foreign keys. Changes tests/inspectdb/tests.py only; no production code.
